name: Islam Makhachev

official.division_note: Moved to welterweight in late 2025; last fight 2026-08-15 (UFC 330).

photo_coverage: Good for the face, adequate for the body. Front: ESPN studio headshot, August 2026 UFC 330 weigh-in (Getty, reference-only) and a November 2025 Dagestan ceremony (CC BY 3.0). Three-quarter and near-profile: 2022-2023 Dagestan government photos (CC BY 3.0, small). Physique: two ESPN lightweight-era cutouts plus the 2026 welterweight weigh-in (upper body only). No sharp true profile.

face.shape: Long oval with a broad, tall forehead; the cheeks taper slightly to a medium jaw. The full beard extends the lower face, so overall it reads long and slightly inverted-triangular.
face.jaw: Medium width, moderately defined; mostly hidden by the beard. Jaw angles sit just below the ears.
face.chin: Medium, rounded, hidden by the beard; the beard comes to a soft rounded point below it.
face.cheekbones: Moderately prominent; cheeks lean and flat under them, a little fuller at welterweight (2026).
face.brow_ridge: Moderate; the brows sit close to the eyes.
face.forehead: Broad and fairly tall, smooth, with faint horizontal lines when the brows are raised (2026 weigh-in).

eyes.shape: Almond, medium, with a light upper-lid fold; fairly open. Outer corners level.
eyes.colour: Light brown to hazel with a green tint (clear in the ESPN headshot and the 2026 weigh-in). Closest embed iris: brownlight (or green at low intensity).

eyebrows.shape: Fairly straight and low, slightly higher at the outer third with short tails; often raised in the centre when he poses (2026 weigh-in).

nose.bridge: Straight and fairly narrow from the front.
nose.hump: None to very slight; the near-profile (2023) shows a straight to gently convex line.
nose.tip: Rounded and a little full, pointing slightly down.

face.mouth_lips: Medium-narrow mouth. Thin upper lip under a short, sparse moustache; medium lower lip. Resting expression closed, lips pressed, corners level to slightly down.

ears.cauliflower_ear: Yes, moderate on both ears. The ears look compact and thick, with the inner folds filled in and lumpy, most visible on the left ear in the 2023 near-profile and on both ears in the studio headshot.

hair.style: Very short buzz cut, roughly even all over with a short taper at the sides and neck; no skin fade.
hair.hairline: Straight and fairly low across the centre with squared, slightly receded temple corners; dense.
hair.notes: Often wears a black baseball cap in public (2022 photos).

facial_hair.colour: Black to very dark brown; reads darker than the head hair because it is denser.
facial_hair.density: Dense on the chin and along the jaw; moderate on the cheeks; the moustache is noticeably sparser and trimmed short.
facial_hair.length_mm: About 25-35 mm at the chin in 2025-2026, about 10 mm on the cheeks; longer (about 40-50 mm at the chin) in February 2023.
facial_hair.shape: Full beard with a natural, fairly low cheek line, connected soul patch, and a short, sparse moustache that leaves the upper lip visible. The chin part is longest and rounded. Neck below the beard is not shaved high.

skin.tone_note: Each sample is the median of a box on well-lit skin (box in source pixels). Studio (ESPN/UFC) cutouts are high-key and warm-graded, so they read lighter and pinker than arena or daylight photos; the average mixes lighting on purpose.
skin.undertone: Neutral to slightly warm, with a light pink flush on the cheeks and nose under flash.
skin.freckles_marks: No freckles visible. Moderate dark chest hair across the pecs and sternum; dark hair on forearms and lower legs.

body.build: Solid, medium-tall (178 cm) wrestler's build with equal height and reach. At welterweight (August 2026) the chest, shoulders and arms are fuller and smoother than in the lightweight-era studio cutouts.
body.body_fat_notes: Lean but not shredded: a faint ab outline in the studio cutouts; at the 2026 welterweight weigh-in the torso is smooth with little visible ab definition.
body.shoulders: Broad and rounded, with thick traps that slope into the neck.
body.chest: Broad and moderately thick, with moderate dark chest hair.
body.arms: Strong, rounded biceps and forearms; not bodybuilder-sized.
body.waist: Moderately narrow at lightweight; thicker at welterweight, so the V-taper is mild.
body.legs_calves: Thick thighs, medium calves; legs of average length.
body.posture: Upright but relaxed, shoulders slightly rounded forward, arms hanging slightly in front; calm, neutral stance. Fights southpaw.
body.notable_physique_traits: No tattoos at all; chest hair; thick neck and traps; balanced, sturdy frame rather than lanky or bulky.

tattoos_note: None visible: torso, arms and legs are bare in both ESPN cutouts and the August 2026 weigh-in.
accessories_seen: Wristwatch on the left wrist (2025), black baseball cap (2022).

kit.typical_shorts: Studio cutouts (title era): white-to-grey shorts printed with line-art mountain peaks, a black lower panel with gold trim and gold 'MAKHACHEV' lettering on his left leg, black waistband with a gold UFC wordmark, crypto.com logo. August 2026 weigh-in: only the top edge of dark maroon shorts is visible.
kit.gloves: Standard black UFC gloves in studio shots.

morphs_not_in_embed._note: assets/embed/mh-manifest.json has no ear targets; estimates for standard MakeHuman ear modifiers to suggest compact, thick cauliflower ears if they are added.

notes: Confidence: high for hair, beard, skin, eye colour and the absence of tattoos; medium for face proportions (good fronts, only small or capped side views); medium for the 2026 welterweight body (upper body only). 8 photos: 4 Commons CC BY 3.0, 4 reference-only (3 ESPN, 1 Getty Aug 2026). What to watch: (1) The beard is the main recognition cue: full, near-black, longest and rounded at the chin, with a SHORT, SPARSE moustache that shows the upper lip; a generic full beard with a heavy moustache will look wrong. (2) Very short even buzz cut (about 1.5 cm), not a fade. (3) Long straight nose, tall broad forehead, hazel-green-brown eyes. (4) Cauliflower ears on both sides (thick, compact); the embed has no ear morphs, so a normal ear is the fallback. (5) No tattoos anywhere, moderate chest hair. (6) Body: at 170 lb he is smooth and solid, mild V; scale to 177.8 cm. ageOldM uses (years-25)/65 like src/avatar3d.js; l-/r- values are symmetric.
